purpose: Characterize current production samples before any timing adjustment; this protocol does not authorize clinical promotion.

sampleMeasurement.independence: Uses final 500 Hz samples and a fixed post-J window, not renderer paths or model T apex/T end; generator QRS onset and J anchor are explicitly not clinical annotations.

acceptance.software: Finite nonzero sample features, retained failed/excluded cells, unchanged source/model hashes, inactive-control and own-duration negative controls pass. No monotonic clinical threshold is imposed on an unvalidated surrogate.
acceptance.correction: No correction accepted by this characterization alone. Freeze independent patient holdout, units and temporal annotations before adjustment; require paired improvement and family-specific noninferiority margins fixed before access, causal controls and no relevant regressions.
acceptance.clinical: Independent human clinical review and external patient evidence required; absent here.
